Package net.maswag.falcaun.signal

package net.maswag.falcaun.signal
Concrete numerical signals and derived signals.

IOSignal represents a pair of input and output signals, implemented by IODiscreteSignal and IOContinuousSignal. Signal is a timed sequence of numerical values. SignalMapper and its implementations construct derived signals from the concrete signals, e.g., SimpleSignalMapper and ExtendedSignalMapper.
